summary: Marginal boating day. Winds 10–15 kt, choppy on the bay. Scattered showers and storms build through the afternoon and evening and can spike local seas and gusts. Rain around 48%. Run the pass and any Gulf legs before early afternoon.
gulf_seas: 2 to 4 feet, occasionally to 5 feet, building to 4 to 6 feet, occasionally to 8 feet this afternoon
source: NWS Tampa Bay, Coastal Waters Forecast (CWFTBW)
